05 . This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard Mr. S.K. Sarangi, learned Senior Advocate for the petitioner and Mr. P.B. Tripathy, learned Addl. Standing Counsel for the State.

This is an application for bail under section 439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with E.O.W., Bhubaneswar P.S. Case No.07 dated 21.02.2023 corresponding to C.T. Case No.270 of 2023 pending in the file of learned S.D.J.M., Bhubaneswar for alleged commission of offences under sections 419/420/467/
468/471/120-B of the Indian Penal Code.
The prayer for bail of the petitioner was rejected // 2 // by the learned Special Judge, C.B.I., Court No.1 - cum- Addl. Sessions Judge, Bhubaneswar vide order dated 23.06.2023.

sentences.text:
1 Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner is in judicial custody since 11.04.2023 and she has been charge sheeted under sections 406/419/420/467/468/471/120-B of the I.P.C. and all the offences are triable by Magistrate and he placed the paragraphs 18.15, 18.16 and 18.18 of the charge sheet which read as follows:
"18.15.

Investigation further discloses that Satyabhama Dash is a house wife and has purchased a land i.e. Mouza Malipada, Khata No.-365/926, Plot No.330/2074 A 0.150 Decimal from one Hirendra Kumar Samantaray and others on 19.04.1989.
It was further ascertained that the said land is bounded by a concrete wall since long.

It was also ascertained that while Satyabhama Dash son namely Monoj Kumar Dash went to deposit Rent of Land (Khajana) of said land, he could found that some patches of land have been illegally recorded in the name of one Pradeepta Behera,
Monalisha Behera, Sulochana Pradhan, Damayanti Dash without their knowledge.

It is revealed that // 3 // an unknown lady impersonated her mother as Satyabhama Dash using forged Adhar card sold away some patches of said land to Pradeepta Behera, Monalisha Behera, Sulochana Pradhan and Damayanti Dash.
It is further revealed that the Adhar card No.xxxxxxxx5332 mentioned against Satyabhama Dash name in the fraudulent sale deed is fake one and not her actual Adhar card number.
It is further revealed that, the photograph as well as her signature available in the sale deed are also forged and fabricated.

It is further revealed from the sale deed that one Krushan Chandra Behera, S/o- Ekadashi Behera of vill- Chiramaru, P.S.- Banki,
Dist- Cuttack had identified the impersonated lady before the Sub-Registrar,
Khandagiri at the time of execution of the forged RSD.
18.16.

Investigation reveals that accused Gayatri Malik, W/o- Ram Krushna Mallik has impersonated her as Satyabhama Dash, W/o- Baman Charan Dash in pursuance to the criminal conspiracy with the identifier Krushna Chandra Behera and others have illegally sold away the four patches of land // 4 // of Satyabhama Dash i.e.
Mouza Malipada, Khata No-365/926, Plot No-330/2074 A 0.150 Decimal.

It is further revealed that Gayatri Mallik used forged Adhar card No.xxxxxxxx5332 and photograph in a most fraudulent manner to forge the actual Adhar card of bonafide owner of the land namely, Satybhama Dash and also has physically remain present during execution of the forged sale deeds in the office of Sub- Register, Khandagiri i.e. on 30.01.2018, 21.04.2018 and 30.06.2018 to execute RSD in favour of Pradeepta Behera; Monalisha Behera, Sulochana Pradhan and Damayanti Dash.
Xxx Xxx Xxx 18.18.
It is revealed that identifier Krushna Chandra Behera knowing very well that Gayatri Mallik has impersonated as Satyabhama Dash identified|hei as Satyabhama Dash.

Krushna Chandra Behera had identified the impersonated lady as Gayatri Mallik and facilitated the execution of the fraudulent sale deed in favour or Pradeepta Behora, Monalisha Behera, Sulochana Pradhan, and Damayanti Dash.

It // 5 // is further revealed that Krushna Chandra Behera along with Gayatri Mallik has taken Rs.10,000/ from accused persons namely Anataryami Senapati and Haladhar Dash to remain present at SR office at the time of execution of sale deed.

sentences.text:
Learned counsel further submitted that the co- accused persons have already been released on bail and the case of the petitioner may be favourably considered, particularly keeping in view the proviso to section 437(1) of Cr.P.C.
Learned counsel for the State, on the other hand, opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the petitioner impersonated one Satyabhama Dash and thereafter the alleged transactions were made and she was also identified in test identification parade.
Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the respective parties, the nature of accusation, the period of detention of the petitioner in judicial custody, release of co-accused persons on // 6 // bail and keeping in view the proviso to section 437(1) of Cr.P.C
, I am inclined to release the petitioner on bail.

Let the petitioner be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing cash security of Rs.10,000/-
(rupees ten thousand) along with bail bond of Rs.50,000.00 (rupees fifty thousand) with two local solvent sureties each for the like amount to the satisfaction of the Court in seisin over the matter with further terms and conditions as the learned Court may deem just and proper including the conditions that the petitioner shall appear before the learned trial Court on each date to which the case is posted for trial, shall not try to tamper with the prosecution evidence.
Violation of any of the conditions shall entail cancellation of bail.
Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
Issue urgent certified copy as per Rules.
